# Does your page's JSON-LD actually say what the page says?

> Paste a page's HTML and see whether its JSON-LD (FAQPage, HowTo, Article, Product, LocalBusiness/Organization, Review) actually says, word for word, what the page's own visible text says. Google requires FAQPage and HowTo content to be visible. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
